title: Fixed-matching scalar RG flow and effective-potential scale cancellation
scope: Four canonical real scalars only. Reference v=1 is the fixed matching unit; it is not redefined at each scale. Original Candidate 1 inputs unchanged.

tests.positive_tree_Hessian: All sampled backgrounds at all flow scales must have positive scalar masses squared before a real CW evaluation.
tests.quartic_boundedness: At each sampled scale lambda_phi,lambda_X,lambda_D>0, c,d>=0, alpha>-sqrt(lambda_X*lambda_D) gives a sufficient strict quartic lower bound.
tests.RG_identity: beta dot parameter derivatives of V0 = Tr[(M squared)^2]/(32*pi^2). Evaluate with direct polynomial derivatives and a separately constructed Hessian; relative residual <1e-11.
tests.strict_order_scale_cancellation: V0(theta0)+t beta0 dot dV0 + V1(theta0,mu0 exp(t)) is scale independent at one-loop. Absolute spread <1e-16 v^4 on the prescribed grid.
tests.loop_bookkeeping: For theta=theta0+eta*t*beta0, evaluate V0(theta)+eta V1(theta,mu0 exp(t)) at eta=1,1/2,1/4,1/8. For t=+/-ln2,+/-ln4, residual scale variation divided by eta squared must converge: adjacent values differ by <3%.
tests.running_potential: Tabulate V0 and V0+V1 on the same one-loop RG trajectory. Residual variation is an uncomputed-higher-order diagnostic, not a rigorous two-loop uncertainty or different physical matching data.
tests.solver_reproducibility: Maximum absolute difference between prescribed ODE tolerances <1e-12 for all dimensionless parameters.
